propositions: The review-bot container lacks an explicitly configured AWS region, causing boto3 to resolve None and raise NoRegionError at BedrockProvider construction
REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset in the container environment, so build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider, triggering boto3 ambient resolution which fails
The cutover has no cross-provider fallback, so a missing region causes hard failure of the LLM-Review gate rather than degradation
boto3 resolves region from AWS_DEFAULT_REGION but not AWS_REGION on this botocore version, and IMDS does not supply region even when reachable
pydantic-ai raises UserError (not an LLMConfigError subclass) when region is missing, so rebar's fail-closed exception handlers do not catch it

The review-bot container must set either REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION explicitly; a preflight check should raise a typed LLMConfigError naming the setting before BedrockProvider construction
